analysis: The changes in ProviderLoop.swift (head 343-344, 356-404) add or alter only stored state for Autopilot. The autopilotHistory tuple gains named fields plus a detail string. New fields: autopilotAdoptedModelIDs, autopilotHolds, the download settings override and storage report, autopilotDownloadCoordinator, autopilotInventoryAwaitingRegistration, cache sweep and candidate verification tasks, a test registration seam, a busy clock, the transition watchdog, stalled-command and startup-preload state, the reslice generation and transition generations. ProviderLoopConfig.swift (head 13-15, 45-46, 52) adds an optional autopilotPendingCandidates field, nil without saved consent, described as cached builds to verify in the background before joining the Autopilot set. No change to keys, attestation, encryption or registration logic is visible in these units. The init (head 853-856) still admits autopilot inventory only if it has a non-empty weightHash, is CBv2-supported and meets runtime eligibility, and keeps it separate from advertisedModels, so ordinary serving permission is unchanged. No regression was found locally. Questions for integration, since the consuming implementations are not in this batch: (1) Does startAutopilotCandidateVerification, referenced at head 377-380, hash pending candidates before inserting them into autopilotInventoryModels? Check that an unverified build cannot join without a weight hash, and that a replaced weight cannot persist (T-012, T-027, A-004, T-054). (2) Do autopilotAdoptedModelIDs keep serving after the lease (head 356-358)? Check that this respects retiringModels/failedSelfTestHashes and the attestation model_hashes/liveModelHashes reporting (T-034, T-027). (3) Do builds fetched by autopilotDownloadCoordinator reach the coordinator only via register (head 371-374)? Check that weight hashes are reported before routing and that the planned reconnect cannot bypass the retirement admission barrier or T-053 binding. (4) The test seam at head 383-384 should stay nil in production. (5) Does the autopilotHistory detail string reach the coordinator or the state file? Check that it carries no prompt data (A-001, T-058).
